title: Tutorial config
description: Declarative click-path that drives a website with Playwright and renders an annotated PDF tutorial. A composable 'graph' of nodes (with branches and reusable fragments).

name.description: Human-readable title of the tutorial or fragment.

kind.description: 'tutorial' is a runnable flow, 'fragment' is a reusable subgraph included via a fragment node, 'artifact' is a rendered run that carries captured screenshots.

start_url.description: URL the browser opens before traversal starts. Optional for fragments that begin with their own 'goto'.

headless.description: Run the browser without a visible window.

params.description: Typed inputs this tutorial or fragment accepts. Callers bind them via a fragment node's 'with'. Values are referenced in steps as ${param:NAME}.

paramSpec.description: Declaration of a single input parameter.

required.description: If true, traversal fails when the param is unbound and has no default.

default.description: Value used when the caller does not bind this param.

secret.description: If true, the value is sensitive (e.g. a password). It must be supplied at run time via ${env:...} or a secretRef and is never written into committed JSON or logs.

graph.description: A directed graph of steps. Traversal begins at 'start' and follows each node's 'next' edges until a node has no successor.

nodes.description: Map of node id -> node. Every edge target and the 'start' must exist here.

stepNode.description: A graph node that performs one interaction (a step) and then follows 'next'.

id.description: Optional explicit id (the map key is authoritative).

description.description: Caption shown on the screenshot for this step.

action.description: Interaction to perform after the screenshot is captured.

value.description: Text to fill, key to press, or URL to navigate to. Supports ${param:NAME} and ${env:NAME} substitution.

highlight.description: Draw the red highlight circle around the target element.

status.description: Checkpoint state. 'verified' means the locator resolved on the live site.

screenshot.description: ARTIFACT ONLY: relative path to the captured PNG for this node, written by the renderer. Never authored by hand.

allOf.description: Non-goto steps need a locator to find the element.
goto and select require a value.
fill needs either a value or a secretRef.

fragmentNode.description: A graph node that inlines another tutorial/fragment file, binding its params via 'with', then follows 'next'.

id.description: Optional explicit id (the map key is authoritative).

description.description: Optional human-readable label for the included fragment.

use.description: Path (relative to this file) of the fragment/tutorial JSON to inline.

with.description: Bindings for the included file's params. Values may be literals or ${param:NAME}/${env:NAME} references; secrets should use a secretRef.

next.description: Successor edge(s). A string is a single successor node id. An array describes conditional branches; the first edge whose 'when' matches is taken, falling back to the single edge that has no 'when'.

condition.description: Branch predicate evaluated against the live page / variable scope. Provide exactly one of 'visible', 'exists', or 'var' (+ 'equals').

visible.description: True when the located element is present and visible.

exists.description: True when the located element is attached to the DOM (visible or not).

var.description: Name of a param/variable in scope to compare with 'equals'.

equals.description: Value the 'var' must equal for the condition to be true.

secretRef.description: Reference to a sensitive value resolved at run time and never committed.

env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the secret.

locator.description: A robust way to find an element. Provide exactly one strategy. Preference order when authoring: role > label > testId > text > css.

role.description: ARIA role, e.g. 'button', 'link', 'textbox'. Usually paired with 'name'.

label.description: Associated <label> text of a form control.

text.description: Visible text content of the element.

css.description: CSS selector (least resilient; use as a last resort).
